current_state_authority: A known current non-Connected PriceStatus in either immediate sample vetoes continuation, even if the callback says Connected. This does not certify a physical outage.

unknown_identity_and_io_policy: Unknown/null/unstable state, identity mismatch or diagnostic failure stops and latches. No callback can revive a stopped session.
snapshot_limit: The indicator lock is not a provider-state lock. Double sampling detects observed changes; it does not prove an atomic snapshot or event creation time.
